gen-gf-revalia-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Bold, loose and spaced out, Revalia stretches its letters wide across the line. Schibsted Grotesk sits below with big, open-looking e and a shapes, friendly and easy to follow.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sen: Sen reads like a ballpoint line, smooth and pressure-free from start to finish. Snowburst One brings stencil bridges and tall, wide-gapped letters up top, while the plain sans below can be sized freely to taste.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sintony: Pipe-cleaner strokes, oversized lowercase, wide-open curves: Tektur looks built from bent wire. Sintony follows with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, so paragraphs of it keep flowing.
gen-gf-unkempt-archivo: Rough-edged and loud, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched in weight. Archivo takes over below with a tall x-height and curves that open outward, so heading and text feel like a shout followed by a clear explanation.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-asap: Asap reads as an open, readable plain sans, its c forms curving like easy arcs. Unkempt above it is flat and contrast-free with gaps keeping c from becoming o, and the two feel like a loud voice beside a patient one.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Commanding from the first word, Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight. Be Vietnam Pro counters with a high mean line and curve endings that never crowd, a sans-serif of quiet precision against that rough shout.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-epilogue: Unkempt brings a commanding, hand-roughened look with gaps that keep c from closing into o. Epilogue does the quieter job, a wire-like plain sans with tall lowercase and stubby ascenders that carries text, where Unkempt carries attitude.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-fira-sans: A t with crossbar and stem matched in weight gives Unkempt its blunt, commanding stamp, made for announcing things. And Fira Sans, a plain sans with a larger-than-usual x-height and wide-open s curves, does the patient work of carrying the explanation.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans also gives Unkempt, rough and expressive above it, a steady sans-serif partner that lets the heading keep all its attitude.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-public-sans: Unkempt is commanding and expressive, its t crossbar and stem matching in weight, and it loses some bite if made small. Public Sans, hefty and broad in its counters, needs no help at larger sizes.
